lines: Create an account switching device. A device is a container, scoped to one browser or app install, that holds multiple sessions and tracks which one is active. Once a device exists, session creation endpoints attach the new session to it automatically, so a single browser can stay signed in to several accounts and switch between them. A device holds at most one session per user: signing in again as a user it already holds replaces that user's session. The device lives as long as its newest session.

-                The device secret is returned in a cookie, and in the response only when the device was just created. Run this on app start: if the browser already has a valid device, the existing one is returned with the same status code instead of an error, so it is always safe to call.
